definitions.explanation: Describes an attitude of looking down on others and behaving as though one is superior. Strongly negative in connotation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尊大|そんだい}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{尊大|そんだい}な⟦{物言|ものい}い→物言い：13487_monoii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反感|はんかん}→反感：08675_hankan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: His arrogant way of speaking invited resentment from those around him.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{尊大|そんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふるまう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{好|す}かれていない→好く：30762_suku⟧。
examples.english: That boss acts overbearing toward his subordinates, so nobody likes him.

notes:
Composed of {尊|そん} (noble, revered) + {大|だい} (great, big). Despite the positive meaning of its components, the word is entirely negative, describing someone who acts as if they are more important than others. It implies a conscious, deliberate display of superiority rather than mere confidence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {尊大|そんだい}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: haughty attitude
- {尊大|そんだい}な⟦{物言|ものい}い→物言い：13487_monoii⟧: arrogant way of speaking
- {尊大|そんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふるまう: to behave arrogantly
- {尊大|そんだい}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: arrogant person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傲慢|ごうまん}→傲慢：07635_gouman⟧: arrogant — similar meaning but emphasizes insolent disregard for others
- ⟦{横柄|おうへい}→横柄：07317_ouhei⟧: domineering — implies rudeness and high-handedness in manner
- {偉|えら}そう: acting important — a more colloquial way to describe someone putting on airs
- ⟦{謙虚|けんきょ}→謙虚：00215_kenkyo⟧: modest, humble — the opposite quality
